title: Checkout console clone
instruction: A customer checkout is stuck before payment. Work inside the cloned application surfaces — Simulated checkout UI, Simulated admin console, Simulated support inbox, and Simulated returns desk — to restore tax, complete the purchase through the UI, issue a partial refund, authorize a return, and leave an audit note. Do not skip the UI via a raw API, and do not wipe inventory.

tools.name: fill_field
tools.description: Fill a visible form field on the current surface

tools.description: Click a named control on the current surface

tools.name: set_tax_rate
tools.description: Set tax rate in the Simulated admin console

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Issue a refund from the Simulated admin console

tools.name: authorize_return
tools.description: Authorize a return on the Simulated returns desk

tools.name: run_terminal
tools.description: Inspect in-world inventory and checkout health

Purchase completed through the cloned UI
Return authorized on the Simulated returns desk
